answer: Each identity’s standing is a glacier that only moves when it works in every epoch — its nadir, the lowest verified work it did in any single epoch, is the floor of its standing. A knoll of trust grows only from a nadir that keeps rising, so a fake that works in bursts and idles in between stays at zero: each fake must do real, verified work in its weakest epoch too, checked by established peers, and a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy a high nadir — each one must keep its own floor rising, one epoch at a time.
